To calculate $17 \times 23$, we can break the multiplication down using the distributive property:

1.  Split 23 into $20 + 3$.
2.  Multiply 17 by 20:
    $$17 \times 20 = 340$$
3.  Multiply 17 by 3:
    $$17 \times 3 = 51$$
4.  Add the two results together:
    $$340 + 51 = 391$$

Thus, $17 \times 23 = 391$.
